purpose: Model-swap stress test of C3a (near-orthogonality) using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
notes: GPU 1 used for vllm generation (turn1+turn2, ~4 min) and HF hidden-state extraction (turn1+turn2, ~6 min total). Step4_probes is CPU-only (OpenBLAS lbfgs, 128 threads, ~24 min wall-clock). Total GPU use: ~10 min on GPU 1. Probe fitting used no GPU — pure CPU. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1,2,3,5,6 was set; vllm with tensor_parallel_size=1 used only the first visible GPU (physical GPU 1). All gpu_ids are subset of {1,2,3,5,6} as required by HARD CONSTRAINT.
